description: Parse a regex pattern's capture groups (numbered and named) and backreferences, and flag any backreference pointing at a group that doesn't exist or hasn't finished being defined yet at that point in the pattern (a forward reference or self-reference). Structural, non-AI check. Pass the pattern body only, no delimiters or flags.

pattern.description: The regex pattern body to analyze, e.g. (?<year>\d{4})-(?<month>\d{2})\k<year>

name: analyze_regex_groups
